status: specification only; no training, no evaluation this round
namingRule: if the final implementation is the same cross-entropy over re-arranged rows, it is called a group-sampling scheme, not a component constraint; the word constraint is reserved for a loss term that penalises a missing, reversed or replaced component directly

currentGap.training: one signal only: teacher-forced CE against the correct target
currentGap.whyThatMatters: the model never sees a target with the name dropped or the relation reversed, so no gradient is aimed at those shapes
currentGap.scoring: the component checks run at acceptance time and produce no gradient, so they cannot serve as an optimisable loss

componentMap.form: {"text","start","end"} with an assertion that target[start:end] == text
componentMap.buildTime: asserted when the pool is built; rows that fail are listed, not silently dropped
componentMap.gap: pool rows currently carry only signature and a target sentence, so this map does not exist yet

spanWeightedCE.formula: -(sum_t w_t log p(y_t)) / (sum_t w_t), weights 2 on component spans, 1 elsewhere
spanWeightedCE.gradient: through the output logits to the whole encoder-decoder, same path as the existing CE
spanWeightedCE.limits: under teacher forcing a missing form never appears, so this term reweights tokens but does not penalise omission

marginAgainstCorruptions.formula: sum over {drop, rev, state} of max(0, m - s(y) + s(y_c)) with s(y) the per-token mean log-probability

corruptions.y_drop: delete the name or other span
corruptions.y_rev: reverse the relation for relation facts, otherwise replace the relation slot with 的
corruptions.y_state: replace the state with a stative negation or delete it

marginAgainstCorruptions.gradient: two forward passes (or one batched forward), one backward; no rule branch is differentiated
marginAgainstCorruptions.whyItPenalisesOmission: the corrupted sequence is scored by the same model, so a preference for it is measurable and pushable

losses.total: L = L_ce + alpha*L_span + beta*L_margin, starting at alpha 0.5, beta 0.3, m 1.0
losses.guard: dry run without updates to check that alpha*L_span + beta*L_margin stays under 30 percent of L_ce

normalisation.note: the two can disagree; if they do, the report says the conclusion depends on the choice instead of picking the friendlier one

A1.sampling: one draw per fact per step

A2.sampling: one draw per fact per step, rotating

B.data: the same rows and ids as A2

matching.factExposure: every arm sees each fact exactly once per step; k only changes which expression is used
matching.targetTokens: count per step; if the k-expression average differs by more than 5 percent from A1, weight rows by 1/tokens so each fact contributes equal mass, and report the numbers
matching.updateBudget: same optimiser steps, facts per batch, lr and warmup; the extra forward for corruptions is recorded as GPU time, not as extra updates
matching.lossNormalisation: L_ce and L_span per token; L_margin averaged over the three corruptions so beta does not drift with k

ablation.criterion: at least 8 points on the holdout and no new fact loss
if A2 already meets the bar, the constraint term is not needed
if A1 and A2 do not differ, k expressions add no information

ifBEqualsA2: call it a group-sampling scheme, drop the margin term, and do not describe it as a component constraint
ifBEqualsA1: check that the corruptions really score higher than the correct target at baseline
check whether alpha and beta let the auxiliary terms drown the main term
check whether the span weights cover the tokens that actually get dropped

acceptance.holdout: 12-16 new facts frozen before training, unused in any probe or exemplar design
acceptance.regressions: the three regression sets and the existing probes, reported separately
acceptance.seeds: at least three pre-declared seeds, listed per seed, with range and mean shown but not used to hide a failure

missingBeforeItCanRun: component map builder with span assertions
per-kind corruption rules plus an assertion that a corruption differs in exactly one component
a baseline measurement of s(y) - s(y_c) so the margin is not identically zero
a decision on k and on whether 341 rows may grow to 1364 before calling the arms equal-budget
declaredBefore: written before any implementation or training
